claims.content: To transfer the reporting responsibility for a track from one JU to another JU, ensuring that the receiving JU assumes responsibility for reporting the track's position extrapolated to the time of transmission.

goal.raw_text: To transfer the reporting responsibility for a track from one JU to another JU, ensuring that the receiving JU assumes responsibility for reporting the track's position extrapolated to the time of transmission.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has the capability to automatically initiate tracks for release to the interface without operator action.

The track reporting criteria are based on the requirements for the exchange of surveillance information and data usable in providing threat warning information among systems involved in joint operations.
The source of the track data shall be provided (Source TN).
A C2 JU elects to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU elects to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1.

claims.content: The C2 JU elects to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1.
The C2 JU initiates the transfer of reporting responsibility for the track.
The C2 JU transmits a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message to clear IFF/SIF data associated with the track being transferred.
The receiving JU assumes responsibility for reporting the track's position extrapolated to the time of transmission.

If the C2 JU does not have the capability to automatically initiate tracks for release to the interface without operator action, it shall also have the capability to deactivate this automatic capability.
If nonreal-time data is involved in the track reporting, it shall be identified as such and time tags shall be provided; nonreal-time track positions shall not be extrapolated.
The receiving JU assumes responsibility for reporting the track's position extrapolated to the time of transmission.
IFF/SIF data associated with the transferred track is cleared via J7.5 (ACT = 0) message, ensuring no stale identity codes are reported by the previous holder.
The source of the track data is provided as Source TN in subsequent reports from the new responsible JU.
